title: Papua New Guinea | World Coffee Guide
description: A good Papua New Guinea coffee is sweet and gentle, with tropical fruit and a tea-like finish. Almost all of it is arabica grown in the highlands, mostly Typica and Bourbon, and much of it is still picked in small village gardens and carried to the mill along roads that turn to mud in the rain.
